coverage.activationGate: 100% of all English namespaces; no stale, empty or invalid entries

architecture.devicePreference: tk.lang; language is not a gameplay/save field
architecture.gameplay: Canonical GameData, simulation inputs, resource IDs, state and replay seeds remain unchanged
architecture.ui: Keyed messages and read-only presentation views
architecture.ownedLegacy: Canonical English history and server output rendered via explicit legacy pattern registry at owned boundaries
architecture.ugc: Player names and authored chat are kept literal; only validated presetId/system/bot messages localize
architecture.notifications: Local reminders translate at delivery; remote push uses each registered token locale
architecture.migration: server/migrations/0029_localization.sql (optional preset ID; per-device push locale default en)
architecture.native: All completed compact text packs/pages included in installation; fonts use existing system fallback policy
architecture.web: Selected language only fetched/cached; boot subset inline; switching preloads before saving preference
architecture.failure: Localized first-party fallback for unknown provider diagnostics; no arbitrary user text matching
